name: Succubus / Incubus
description: In medieval Christian demonology, the succubus (female) and incubus (male) are demons that seduce humans during sleep through sexual encounters, draining their life force; the tradition appears globally under various names and is now understood to be closely associated with sleep paralysis and hypnagogic hallucinations.

aliases.name: Lilith
aliases.meaning: night demon associated with sexual predation

aliases.name: Mara
aliases.meaning: nightmare spirit that rides sleeping persons

aliases.name: Cambion
aliases.meaning: offspring of a demon and human

origin: The succubus/incubus tradition is found throughout medieval Europe and has functional analogues in cultures worldwide. The specific Christian demonological framework is primarily European (especially Western and Central Europe), but similar nocturnal sexual demon traditions appear across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
